plan.title: verify:ac exits 201 on a passing run and never executes stated plan.acceptance.commands

narratives.Description: verify:ac exits 201 on a passing run and never executes the stated plan.acceptance.commands it resolves
narratives.Overview:
Two independent defects compound on consumer @deftai/directive 0.104.0 (darwin, deftai/agentsentri).

1. verify:ac prints passed with zero failed clauses then exits 201. Documented contract is three-state 0/1/2. go-task historically wraps a failed inner command as TaskRunError 201; the CLI must still emit only 0/1/2, and a printed pass must be exit 0.
2. --capture-only resolves plan.acceptance.commands (acceptance_commands: 9, source_rung: stated) while the executor ledger is empty (commands: 0, rejected: 0). evaluateVerifyAcFromPlan injects plan.acceptance.commands as source=explicit only for derived/project_floor, so stated commands never run. The literal runner then prints 'no stated commands (nothing to run)'.

check cause: quotes the engine:_ts-build script body (set -eu) instead of the failing verify:ac verb.

Fix: run non-empty plan.acceptance.commands as explicit when the literal ledger produced no runs and no blocking rejects; clamp CLI exits to 0/1/2 with ok implying 0; skip go-task cmd-echo lines in check cause extraction.

Do not edit literal-acceptance/evaluate.ts, capture.ts, or safety.ts (live #3511).
